# XPENC

> XPENC is a free, open-source, offline-first personal finance app for Android. It tracks income, expenses, transfers, budgets, savings goals, loans/EMIs, and person-to-person dues entirely in an on-device SQLite database — there is no server, no user account, no analytics, and release builds don't even request the INTERNET permission.

XPENC is built and maintained by one developer, Yash Patil (GitHub: PATILYASHH), and is licensed under the MIT license. The current release is v1.5.0 (August 2026).

## Key facts

- Platform: Android 7.0 and later. No iOS, web, or desktop version.
- Price: free, no ads, no in-app purchases, no subscription.
- Privacy: no server, no accounts, no analytics/trackers, no ads, no SMS permission. Release builds request no INTERNET permission at all.
- License: MIT — source code is public and auditable.
- Distribution: F-Droid (recommended, reproducible build from source), direct APK download, OpenAPK mirror. A Google Play listing is in progress.

## Core features

- Accounts: Cash, Bank, Card and Prepaid Balance types with real, non-double-counted balances.
- Transactions: income, expense and transfer, kept strictly separate; tags and receipt photos supported.
- Budgets: per-category budgets with live progress and overspend alerts; an opt-in "Envelope Mode" for zero-based, every-rupee-has-a-job budgeting.
- Dues: track money lent or borrowed between people, with partial settlements, kept out of budget totals.
- Goals & Loans hub: savings goals with contribution history, plus EMI/loan accounts with an outstanding-balance ring and payment logging.
- Data entry automation: share a bank SMS or a UPI payment screenshot (Paytm/Google Pay/PhonePe) into the app from the Android Share sheet, or import a CSV bank statement — all parsed entirely on-device.
- Split payments: one purchase paid from more than one account posts as linked transactions.
- Shopping lists, calendar/reminders, and PDF statement / CSV export.
- Customization: pick which two tabs sit in the bottom nav (and hide their text labels for icon-only), toggle any account out of the dashboard's Net Worth total, and app-wide text size/boldness/font controls.
- Security: optional 4/5/6-digit PIN with fingerprint/face unlock, a master recovery phrase that backs up the PIN after too many wrong tries, and a per-balance "hide amounts" toggle.
- Seven themes including a true-black AMOLED dark mode.

- [Changelog](https://github.com/PATILYASHH/XPENC/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md): version history and release notes.
